item.title: Subaru PH Says Units NOT Included In North American Fuel System Recall
item.description: Motor Image Pilipinas, Inc. is providing clarity following recent reports of a vehicle recall involving certain Subaru hybrid models in North America. After direct verification with Subaru Corporation, Motor Image Group confirms that Subaru vehicles distributed within its markets, including the Philippines, are not affected by this recall campaign.Read More »

item.title: Toyota Motor PH To Offer Standardized Hybrid Powertrain In 2026 Corolla Altis?
item.description: It’s curious that Toyota Motor Philippines opted to standardize the hybrid powerplant in the crossover derivative of the Corolla (aka Corolla Cross), but not the OG Corolla (aka the Corolla Altis). Two years later, it looks like the carmaker is about to rectify that shortcoming by announcing more variants of the Corolla Altis HEV.Read More »

item.title: Hyundai Motor Asia Pacific Appoints Yukontorn Wisadkosin As ASEAN President
item.description: Hyundai Motor Asia Pacific (HMAP) announced the appointment of Yukontorn Wisadkosin (Vickie) as ASEAN President, effective March 2, 2026. She will lead Hyundai’s integrated ASEAN operations across Indonesia, Thailand, Philippines, Malaysia, and Vietnam, and will report directly to Don Romano, the newly appointed President of Hyundai Motor Asia Pacific.Read More »

item.title: Review: 2026 MG ZS Hybrid+
item.description: The ZS helped catapult MG to mainstream status here in the Philippines. Though the MG 5 has since overtaken it sales-wise, the “ZS effect” remains strong. It’s a recognizable nameplate for its larger-than-segment size, excellent value for money, and reasonable driving dynamics. With the second-generation ZS, MG has maintained most of its predecessor’s qualities, while also imbuing it with added style and a wide array of powertrain choices at the same time.Read More »

item.title: 2026 Nissan Patrol Gets Awarded For Design
item.description: The Nissan Patrol and its North American twin, the Armada, has scooped up the iF Design Award. The awarding is based on a comprehensive evaluation that includes five areas of consideration: idea, form, function, differentiation, and sustainability.Read More »

item.title: The EX5 EM-i PHEV SUV Is Exciting For Geely, But It Also Emphasizes That There Are Still Issues Within Geely Philippines
item.description: If there’s a sign that things still aren’t well over at China-run Geely Motor Philippines, just look at their marketing and IT departments. Despite their marketing department’s constant barrage of teases regarding a potential “BYD Sealion 6 DM-i killer” (yeah, it seems every Chinese crossover now is), their IT department just posted details on the Geely EX5 EM-i in its full, naked glory on their website.Read More »
